戴沐白见叶寒动杀心了，赶紧将锅扔在唐三头上。

事到如今，他也只能让兄弟来背锅了。

唐三背后有唐昊，叶寒应该不会将他怎样吧。

眼下只能委屈一下唐三了。

“戴沐白，你这是什么意思？”

唐三怒了。

他从来就没想过要出卖戴沐白，但却被他出卖了。

这个人怎样如此言而无信，毫无底线。

“小三，我也不想这样，也是被逼无奈啊。”

“这件事我瞒不住了。”

戴沐白见唐三一脸怒色，愧疚地向他表示歉意。

两个人承担，总比他一个人承担要强吧。

“小三，为什么？”

“你为什么要陷害老大！”

“虽然我们跟老大也有恩怨，但也不至于下这么狠的手段吧。”

“你什么时候变得这么阴暗了。”

小舞听着俩人的对话，眼神中满是不可思议，主动与他拉开距离。

“小舞，你听我解释。”

“事情不是你想的那样。”

“戴沐白是问过我的意见，但我只是把一些心里话说了出来。”

“很多事情都是戴沐白一个人决定的，根本就不是他说的那样。”

“当时我也是看你讨厌叶寒，我才给他提点意见的啊。”

“我这样做，都是为了你！”

唐三见小舞对他失望透顶，赶紧向她解释。

本来这件事就与他无关，戴沐白非要给他扣帽子甩锅。

简直不可理喻！

此时此刻，他恨不得撕了戴沐白这张烂嘴。

“我不听，我不听！”

“小三，你太让我失望了！”

“你这样，让我以后还怎么相信你！”

小舞连连摇头，继续与唐三保持距离。

唐三的行为，已经严重践踏了她的信任。

本来就是一件小矛盾，却做出如此见不得人的事情，简直刷新了她对唐三的认知。

“小舞......”

唐三见她的情绪有点失控，别提有多着急了，想要走过去搂抱着她，安慰。

“唐三，你站着，别靠近我。”

“我现在不想看到你！”

小舞见唐三还在向他靠近，闪身来到叶寒的背后，向他发起警告。

虽然叶寒的性格杀伐、冷漠，有点不近人情，不好相处，但他却是一个敢作敢当的男子汉。

不管做了什么事，都敢于承担。

“戴沐白，你这个浑蛋！”

“你为什么要污蔑我。”

“当时我们怎么说的，这件事我不会参与，只是提点意见。”

“为什么你非要把事情都甩在我的头上。”

“今天，你必须把事情说清楚。”

唐三的情绪有点崩溃了，闪身来到戴沐白的面前，揪着他的衣领，脸上满是怒色。

如果不是戴沐白乱说，事情怎会变成这样。

“小三，匿名信的确是我的意愿，可若是没有你给我出谋划策，我也下不了决心啊。”

“是你给我的底气，我才写的。”

Seeing that Ye Han was murderous, Dai Mubai quickly threw the pot on Tang San's head.

At this point, he could only let his brother take the blame.

Tang San had Tang Hao behind him, so Ye Han probably wouldn't do anything to him.

At the moment, Tang San can only feel aggrieved.

"Dai Mubai, what do you mean?"

Tang San was angry.

He never wanted to betray Dai Mubai, but he was betrayed by him.

How could this person be so dishonest and have no bottom line?

"Xiao San, I don't want to be like this either. I'm forced to do nothing."

"I can't hide this anymore."

Dai Mubai saw Tang San's angry look and apologized to him guiltily.

It's better for two people to bear it than for him to bear it alone.

"Mistress, why?"

"Why did you frame the boss!"

"Although we also have grudges with the boss, we won't resort to such cruel methods."

"When did you become so dark?"

Xiao Wu listened to the conversation between the two, her eyes full of disbelief, and took the initiative to distance herself from him.

"Xiao Wu, listen to my explanation."

"It's not what you think."

"Dai Mubai asked me for my opinion, but I just said what was in my heart."

"A lot of things are decided by Dai Mubai alone. It's not what he said at all."

"At that time, I also saw that you hated Ye Han, so I gave him some advice."

"I do this all for you!"

Seeing that Xiao Wu was extremely disappointed with him, Tang San quickly explained to her.

This matter had nothing to do with him in the first place, but Dai Mubai insisted on blaming him for it.

It’s simply unreasonable!

At this moment, he wanted to tear Dai Mubai's mouth apart.

"I won't listen, I won't listen!"

"Xiao San, you disappoint me so much!"

"How can I trust you in the future if you act like this!"

Xiao Wu shook her head repeatedly and continued to keep her distance from Tang San.

Tang San's behavior had seriously violated her trust.

It was originally a small conflict, but to do such a shameful thing simply refreshed her understanding of Tang San.

"Xiao Wu..."

Tang San saw that her emotions were a little out of control, not to mention how anxious she was, so he wanted to go over and hug her to comfort her.

"Tang San, stand still and don't come close to me."

"I don't want to see you now!"

Seeing that Tang San was still approaching him, Xiao Wu ducked behind Ye Han and warned him.

Although Ye Han's character is murderous, indifferent, a bit unhuman and difficult to get along with, he is a man who dares to take action.

No matter what you do, you have the courage to take responsibility.

"Dai Mubai, you bastard!"

"Why are you slandering me?"

"What we said at the time was that I would not be involved in this matter, I was just making some comments."

"Why do you have to put everything on my head?"

"Today, you have to make things clear."

Tang San's mood collapsed a little, and he flashed in front of Dai Mubai, grabbing him by the collar, his face full of anger.

If Dai Mubai hadn't talked nonsense, how could things have turned out like this.

"Xiaosan, the anonymous letter is indeed my wish, but without your advice, I wouldn't be able to make a decision."

"I wrote it because you gave me the confidence."
